from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import KubernetesCluster, CustomClusterToken

class CreateClusterDelegatedTokenView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        cluster_id = request.data.get('cluster_id')
        duration_hours = int(request.data.get('duration_hours', 8))

        cluster = get_object_or_404(KubernetesCluster, id=cluster_id, organization=request.user.organization)

        token = CustomClusterToken.objects.create(
            user=request.user,
            cluster_id=cluster.id,
            valid_hours=duration_hours
        )
        return Response({'token': token.key, 'cluster_id': token.cluster_id}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
